<!-- Prompt Input Area -->
			<GroupBox x:Name="PromptGroupBox" Grid.Row="0"
                      Foreground="{DynamicResource {x:Static vsshell:VsBrushes.WindowTextKey}}"
                      Background="{DynamicResource {x:Static vsshell:VsBrushes.ToolWindowBackgroundKey}}"
                      BorderBrush="{DynamicResource {x:Static vsshell:VsBrushes.WindowTextKey}}"
                      BorderThickness="1"
                      Margin="0,0,0,2"
                      Style="{StaticResource SingleBorderGroupBoxStyle}">
				<GroupBox.Header>
					<TextBlock Text="{local:Loc 'Prompt / Paste Image'}" Opacity="0.93"/>
				</GroupBox.Header>
				<Grid Background="{DynamicResource {x:Static vsshell:VsBrushes.WindowKey}}">
					<Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
						<ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
						<ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
					</Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
					<TextBox x:Name="PromptTextBox"
                         TextWrapping="Wrap"
                         AcceptsReturn="True"
                         VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto"
                         FontFamily="Cascadia Mono"
                         Cursor="IBeam"
                         Background="{DynamicResource {x:Static vsshell:VsBrushes.WindowKey}}"
                         Foreground="{DynamicResource {x:Static vsshell:VsBrushes.WindowTextKey}}"
                         BorderBrush="Transparent"
                         BorderThickness="0"
                         AllowDrop="True"
                         PreviewDragOver="PromptTextBox_PreviewDragOver"
                         PreviewDrop="PromptTextBox_PreviewDrop"
                         KeyDown="PromptTextBox_KeyDown"
                         PreviewKeyDown="PromptTextBox_PreviewKeyDown"
                         TextChanged="PromptTextBox_TextChanged"
                         PreviewMouseWheel="PromptTextBox_PreviewMouseWheel">
					<TextBox.ContextMenu>
						<ContextMenu Style="{StaticResource ModernContextMenuStyle}">
							<MenuItem Header="{local:Loc 'Cut'}" Command="ApplicationCommands.Cut" InputGestureText="Ctrl+X"
							          CommandTarget="{Binding PlacementTarget, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=ContextMenu}}"/>
							<MenuItem Header="{local:Loc 'Copy'}" Command="ApplicationCommands.Copy" InputGestureText="Ctrl+C"
							          CommandTarget="{Binding PlacementTarget, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=ContextMenu}}"/>
							<MenuItem Header="{local:Loc 'Paste'}" Command="ApplicationCommands.Paste" InputGestureText="Ctrl+V"
							          CommandTarget="{Binding PlacementTarget, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=ContextMenu}}"/>
							<Separator/>
							<MenuItem Header="{local:Loc 'Select All'}" Command="ApplicationCommands.SelectAll" InputGestureText="Ctrl+A"
							          CommandTarget="{Binding PlacementTarget, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=ContextMenu}}"/>
							<Separator/>
							<MenuItem Header="{local:Loc 'Clear Prompt History'}" Click="ClearPromptHistoryMenuItem_Click"/>
						</ContextMenu>
					</TextBox.ContextMenu>
				</TextBox>
					<!-- "Keep last prompt visible" (issue #201): the last prompt sent, dimmed, laid over the
					     empty prompt box. Display only — clicks go through to the box and it is never sent. -->
					<TextBlock x:Name="LastPromptHint" Grid.Column="0"
					           IsHitTestVisible="False"
					           Visibility="Collapsed"
					           TextWrapping="Wrap"
					           ClipToBounds="True"
					           Margin="3,1,3,1"
					           Opacity="0.5"
					           FontFamily="{Binding FontFamily, ElementName=PromptTextBox}"
					           FontSize="{Binding FontSize, ElementName=PromptTextBox}"
					           Foreground="{DynamicResource {x:Static vsshell:VsBrushes.WindowTextKey}}"/>
					<!-- Send button (visible only while Enter does not send), tucked into the bottom-right

					<Button x:Name="SendPromptButton" Grid.Column="1"

					        FontSize="14"
					        Style="{StaticResource IconButtonStyle}"
					        Click="SendButton_Click"
					        Visibility="Collapsed"
					        VerticalAlignment="Bottom"
					        ToolTip="{local:Loc 'Send Prompt to Code Agent'}"
					        Margin="4,0,0,0"/>
				</Grid>

anchor='  "Button only — Enter inserts a newline, click Send to submit":'

    idx=[i for i,l in enumerate(lines) if l.startswith(anchor)]
    assert len(idx)==1,(c,idx)
    i=idx[0]
    assert lines[i].rstrip().endswith(','),c
    new=[f"  {json.dumps(L,ensure_ascii=False)}: {json.dumps(a,ensure_ascii=False)},",
         f"  {json.dumps(T,ensure_ascii=False)}: {json.dumps(b,ensure_ascii=False)},"]
    lines[i+1:i+1]=new
    open(p,'wb').write(nl.decode().join(lines).encode('utf-8'))
    json.loads(open(p,encoding='utf-8-sig').read())
print("ok")
EOF

199:## Version History
200-
201-### Version 310.0
202-- The Claude Usage page no longer signs itself out when it thinks the Claude Code account changed, so a Google sign-in there now sticks. Change Account and the page's own Sign Out / Switch Account still sign it out.
203-- Signing out of the Claude Usage page keeps your Google accounts, so signing back in is one click on the account instead of e-mail, password and 2FA again.
README.md:21:- **Multi-line prompts** — Press **Enter** to send, **Shift+Enter** or **Ctrl+Enter** for a new line. To send with Ctrl+Enter instead, or to use a Send button, change the send key in *⚙ → Settings... → Prompt*.
README.md:143:- *Settings...* opens the consolidated dialog with tabs for On Agent Finish, Prompt (send key, large prompts, clipboard, selection as reference, last prompt, font size, @ file picker, usage bars), Automation (auto-open Changes, track agent changes for review, pull before sending, TFVC checkout, auto-send build and runtime errors, Install Caveman, Install latest OpenPets), Terminal (prompt panel position, prompt box, terminal type, encoding, fonts), Native mode (chat tabs, chat window, chat display, icons, chat font), Toolbar (incl. subagent count, ☰/⚡/⚙ position), Appearance (language, theme), CLI Paths (including extra launch arguments), and Backup (save/load all settings to a file)
README.md:554:- **Send button** now appears in the corner of the prompt box (terminal and native chat) when "Button only" send mode is selected, and changing the send key in Settings takes effect in open chats right away.
README.md:1239:- Settings is organized into tabs, Ctrl+Enter can be the send key, and prompt font and usage bar options moved into Settings.
docs/ARCHITECTURE.md:133:- `ComposerSendButton` (➤ Send) was removed outright — the composer's Enter key already sends (`ComposerInput_PreviewKeyDown`, gated by the existing `SendWithEnter`/`SendWithCtrlEnter` settings) independent of any button, so the button was pure clutter next to an increasingly busy action row. The placeholder text now says "Enter to send" in its place. Issue #186 (v227.0): `ComposerSendButton` (▶) is back, but only in "Button only" mode (`SendWithEnter` and `SendWithCtrlEnter` both off) and the composer is in Full mode; it sits inside the input box and raises the same `SendRequested` as the Enter key. Settings Apply and a Backup import call `ApplyChatSendKeySettings()` so the open chat composers pick the new send key up immediately (they only copied it during a full composer refresh before). In terminal mode and the docked chat the panel's `SendPromptButton` now sits in the same bottom-right corner of the prompt box (inside `PromptGroupBox`) instead of the toolbar strip.
docs/ARCHITECTURE.md:364:- Send-key mode: a 3-way radio group ("Send prompt with") maps to two bools — `SendWithEnter` (Enter sends) / `SendWithCtrlEnter` (Ctrl+Enter sends, Enter = newline) / both false (button only). Keyboard handling lives in `PromptTextBox_PreviewKeyDown`. See issue #70
docs/ARCHITECTURE.md:773:- ⧉ is a ☰ Tools menu item only on **both** surfaces, docked panel and the chat's own tab (v177.0 round 4 — Daniel: "leave detach icon only in the tools menu, it will not be very used", then, after round 3 fixed only the docked case: "Docked it worked for the dock/undock icon only in tools. But for the tab it is not good"). `Apply()` renders a feature as a real toolbar button only when the user promoted it (Settings → Toolbar); Detach is normally unpromoted, so `Apply(ToolbarButton.DetachTerminal, true, …)` parks it in the ☰ menu on the panel. Round 3 had reverted a round-2 block that force-showed `DetachToolbarButton` on the panel, but a *separate* mechanism still stood on the tab surface: the composer's promoted-button mirror used to unconditionally insert a standalone `"⧉"` glyph at the front of its strip, on the theory that once the chat owns its tab the panel's whole toolbar (☰ included) is collapsed and unreachable. That theory was wrong — the composer's own ☰ Tools button (`ComposerToolsButton` → `OnComposerConfigMenuClicked`) already reopens the exact same `ToolsContextMenu` instance the panel uses (re-anchored, not copied), so `DetachTerminalMenuItem` was reachable from the tab the whole time. Round 4 deletes the unconditional mirror insert; the promoted-mirror loop now only special-cases `RestartAgent` (it has its own ↻ composer button) and otherwise mirrors exactly the same promoted set as the panel — so ⧉ shows up on the composer's strip only if the user actually promoted it, identically to the panel. Round 4 also fixed a related label bug: `RefreshToolbarLayout`'s trailing icon-sync call used to always pass `_isTerminalDetached` (a classic-terminal-only flag that native mode never sets) into `UpdateDetachButtonIcon`, so the ☰ menu's "Detach Chat to Separate Tab" header could get stuck on that wording even after the chat had moved to its own tab — every `ToolsContextMenu_Opened` re-runs `RefreshToolbarLayout`, which kept re-asserting the stale label. It now passes `IsNativeModeActive ? IsChatDetachedToOwnTab : _isTerminalDetached`.

Since v291.0 both ◀/▶ arrow slots collapse while nothing scrolls, so the strip sits flush against its aligned edge; the left slot used to stay Hidden and read as a gap before the first button), `SelectedClaudeModel`, `SelectedDevinModel` (string — the chosen Devin `model_uid`, shared by Devin (WSL) and Devin (native); empty = Devin's own default), `FavoriteDevinModels` (`List<string>` — Devin models starred as favorites, most recently starred first, uncapped; feeds the model menu's shortcuts and the picker's "Favorites"; v168.0, replaced the automatic `RecentDevinModels` MRU list), `SelectedProviderModels` (`Dictionary<string,string>` keyed by `AiProvider.ToString()` — the chosen model for every other agent; empty value = the agent's default) and `ModelCatalogs` (`Dictionary<string,ModelCatalogCache>` — the lists read from each CLI, 24h TTL; see *Model Catalog & Selection*), `PromptHistory` (max 50), `KeepLastPromptVisible` (default false — Settings → Prompt; the last prompt sent from the panel is laid over the empty prompt box as a dimmed, hit-test-invisible `LastPromptHint` TextBlock, set from `AddToPromptHistory` and re-evaluated on every `PromptTextBox` text change; in memory only, display only, never sent; issue #201), `AutoOpenChangesOnPrompt`, `PendingReviewEnabled` (default false — "Track agent changes for review (Keep/Undo)"; see *Pending Review*), `ChangesViewPendingScope` (default true — last scope chosen in the Changes view when pending review is on: pending list vs all uncommitted), `ClaudeDangerouslySkipPermissions`, `CodexFullAuto`, `CursorAgentAutoRun`, `DevinDangerousMode`, `AntigravityDangerouslySkipPermissions`, `QwenCodeYoloMode`, `GrokAlwaysApprove` (default false — `--always-approve` for Grok in terminal and native mode), `SelectedEffortLevel`, `SelectedCodexReasoningLevel` (default `Default` — Codex `model_reasoning_effort`, left to the model), `CustomWorkingDirectory` (global fallback) and `ProjectWorkingDirectories` (`Dictionary<string,string>` keyed by solution name — per-solution override that wins over it; issue #100), `SelectedTerminalType`, `ConsoleFontFaceName` (default `Cascadia Mono`) / `ConsoleFontSizePt` (default 0 = the terminal's own size; Ctrl+Scroll adjusts from it), `IsTerminalDetached`, `PromptFontSize` (8–24pt), `InvertLayout`, `SelectedLayoutOrientation` (default `Horizontal` — with `InvertLayout` it puts the prompt panel Top/Bottom/Left/Right; Settings → Layout), `HidePromptPanel` (default false — collapses the prompt text box, terminal reclaims the space; controls row/⚙ menu stay reachable to toggle back; ignored in native mode), `AutoHidePromptInNativeMode` (default true — collapses the panel prompt box while the native chat is in its own tab, whose composer replaces it; ignored while the chat is docked in the panel; issue #151), `AutoHidePanelInNativeMode` (default true — hides the whole panel once the native chat is on screen in its own tab; v258.0), `ChatIconStyle` (default Classic — Modern: VS icons on the chat toolbar, ring spinner, colored tab status), `ChatWorkingTabIcon` (default Clock — Modern working tab icon: Arrows, Clock, Moon), `ShowChatTokenCounts` (default true — token counts in the live status and the turn footer), `ExpandFailedToolCalls` (default true — a failed tool call opens its card by itself; see *All chats in one window*; v276.0), `ReopenChatTabsWithSolution` (default false — reopen the native chat tabs per workspace; see *Reopening chat tabs with the solution*; replaced the v263.0 `ReopenChatTabsOnSolutionOpen`, default true, in v277.0 — `DropRetiredReopenChatTabsSetting` removes the old key from `AdditionalData` once and clears `WorkspaceChatTabs`, so every install starts with it off) / `WorkspaceChatTabs` (the saved lists), `CompactChatToolbar` (default false — chat toolbar inside the message box), `WelcomeCardContent` (default `RecentAndTips` — what a new chat's welcome card shows: `Nothing`, `TipsOnly`, `RecentOnly`, `RecentAndTips`), `PlainChatWorkingStatus` (default false — live status always "Thinking…" instead of rotating verbs; v259.0), `SelectedThemePreference` (Automatic/Dark/Light/Custom), `CustomThemeColorArgb` (bg color for Custom, default #F4ECFF), `LastAgentTerminalColorArgb` (agent's launched color, skips redundant restart prompts), `SkipThemeRestartPrompt` (default false), `DefaultNativeSessionColor` (`"#RRGGBB"`, empty = built-in blue `#1C8AE0` — Settings → Appearance → Native Color Schema; fallback for native sessions with no entry in `SessionTitleColors`, resolved in `GetNativeSessionColor`; applying it live-refreshes open chats), `CustomCommands` (list of `{Name, Command}`), `UsageAutoRefreshSeconds` (0 = manual), `UsageWindowOpened` (auto-reopen on load), `ShowInlineUsageBars` (default true), `ShowSubagentCount` (default false — live running-subagent count in the panel toolbar, Claude Code only; see *Subagent Count*), `LastUsageJson` / `LastUsageTimestamp` (cached snapshot), `SendLargePromptsAsFile` (default false — when true, prompts >1 KB are sent as a file reference instead of inline paste), `AgentFinish` (`AgentFinishConfig` — legacy global config from before v222.0, no longer applied at runtime; only pre-fills a solution that has no settings of its own yet), `ProjectAgentFinish` (`Dictionary<string,AgentFinishConfig>` — the per-solution settings, keyed by solution name (folder name in Open Folder mode); a solution without an entry has the feature off), `CustomExecutablePaths` (`Dictionary<AiProvider,string>` — per-provider custom CLI executable path override; empty/missing entries fall back to PATH/native detection), `ExtraLaunchArgs` (`Dictionary<AiProvider,string>` — per-provider extra flags appended verbatim to the agent's launch command in **both** the embedded terminal and native mode; see *Auto-Send Build Errors*), `AutoSendRuntimeErrorsToAgent` (default false — when true, an unhandled runtime exception hit under the debugger auto-sends the exception + stack trace to the running agent; see *Auto-Send Runtime Errors*), `AtMentionEnabled` (default true — Settings → Prompt → "Show the @ file picker"; false = "@" is plain text, no indexing; v276.0), `AtMentionFileTypes` / `AtMentionExcludedFolders` (strings, default empty — Settings → Prompt → "@ file picker": extensions the "@" picker lists and extra folders it skips; lines: // You can specify all the values or you can default the Build and Revision Numbers
// by using the '*' as shown below:
// Exposes internal helpers to the test project so the pure logic (path encoding, git status
// parsing, WSL command building, prompt formatting) can be tested without a running Visual Studio.
- Pick an AI provider, *Configure Visible Code Agents...*

- Provider-specific flags: Claude *Skip Permissions* and *Start in Plan Mode*, Codex *Approval Never*, Cursor *Yolo Mode*, Devin *Dangerous Mode*, Antigravity *Skip Permissions*, Qwen Code *Yolo Mode*, Grok *Always Approve*
- *Hide Prompt Input Box*, *Configure Custom Commands...*, *Settings...*, About

-- *Settings...* opens the consolidated dialog with tabs for On Agent Finish, Prompt (send key, large prompts, clipboard, selection as reference, last prompt, font size, @ file picker, usage bars), Automation (auto-open Changes, track agent changes for review, pull before sending, TFVC checkout, auto-send build and runtime errors, Install Caveman, Install latest OpenPets), Terminal (prompt panel position, prompt box, terminal type, encoding, fonts), Native mode (chat tabs, chat window, chat display, icons, chat font), Toolbar (incl. subagent count, ☰/⚡/⚙ position), Appearance (language, theme), CLI Paths (including extra launch arguments), and Backup (save/load all settings to a file)

+- *Settings...* opens the consolidated dialog with tabs for On Agent Finish, Prompt (send key, Send button position, large prompts, clipboard, selection as reference, last prompt, font size, @ file picker, usage bars), Automation (auto-open Changes, track agent changes for review, pull before sending, TFVC checkout, auto-send build and runtime errors, Install Caveman, Install latest OpenPets), Terminal (prompt panel position, prompt box, terminal type, encoding, fonts), Native mode (chat tabs, chat window, chat display, icons, chat font), Toolbar (incl. subagent count, ☰/⚡/⚙ position), Appearance (language, theme), CLI Paths (including extra launch arguments), and Backup (save/load all settings to a file)

**☰ Tools dropdown**: Holds *Update Code Agent*, *Restart Code Agent*, *Detach/Attach Terminal*, *View Code Changes*, *Session History*, *Show Usage*, *Set Working Directory...*, *Send Build Errors to Agent*, *Generate Commit Message*, *Generate Commit Message, Commit and Push*, *Recommend AI Model*, and *GitHub Issues*. Promote any of these to one-click toolbar buttons — and reorder them by dragging — via *⚙ → Settings... → Toolbar*; promoted features leave the dropdown, which hides once they all become buttons.

+- **Send button in the toolbar**: a new option in *⚙ → Settings... → Prompt* puts the Send button back with the other toolbar buttons, as before version 227.0, instead of in the corner of the prompt box ("Button only" send mode, off by default).

- The Claude Usage page no longer signs itself out when it thinks the Claude Code account changed, so a Google sign-in there now sticks. Change Account and the page's own Sign Out / Switch Account still sign it out.
- Signing out of the Claude Usage page keeps your Google accounts, so signing back in is one click on the account instead of e-mail, password and 2FA again.

<Description xml:space="preserve">Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Open Code, Devin, PI, Antigravity, Reasonix, Qwen Code, Grok in Visual Studio. Image/file paste, diff viewer, on-finish actions, usage tracking, session history and more</Description>
- Single entry point: `Settings...` menu item in the ⚙ context menu, consolidating all previously-scattered toggles

- Tabbed layout: `ShowConsolidatedSettingsDialogAsync()` builds a themed `TabControl` via the local `AddTab(header)` helper: On Agent Finish (first tab since v223.0 — the most used setting; every option inline, built by `BuildAgentFinishSettingsContent` in AgentFinishDialog.cs, replacing the separate window), Prompt (send-key mode, large-prompt/clipboard/selection-reference sending, prompt font size, "@" file picker filters), Automation (auto-open Changes, track agent changes for review, git pull before sending, TFVC checkout, auto-send build/runtime errors) — split out of the former single Behavior tab in v222.0, which had outgrown the dialog height; the dialog is 840px wide (v223.0) so all nine tab headers fit on one row (a `TabPanel` wraps to a second row otherwise), Terminal (prompt-panel position, hide prompt input box, terminal type, console font and size, encoding), Native mode (chat tabs: reopen with the solution, status, automatic names; chat window: all chats in one window, hide the panel / its prompt box; chat display: token counts, failed tool calls, plain status, compact toolbar; chat icons; chat font) — the two open with a banner that switches the mode; the former Layout tab was split between them in v280.0, its usage bars went to Prompt, the subagent count to Toolbar and the language to Appearance, Toolbar (before Appearance since v280.0), Appearance (formerly Theme: the extension's language, theme preference incl. custom-color hex box + `ColorDialog` picker, skip-restart-prompt), CLI Paths (per-provider custom CLI executable paths — content built by `BuildCliPathsTabContent`, applied via `ApplyCliPathChanges`), Backup. Each tab is a `ScrollViewer` + `StackPanel`

- Send-key mode: a 3-way radio group ("Send prompt with") maps to two bools — `SendWithEnter` (Enter sends) / `SendWithCtrlEnter` (Ctrl+Enter sends, Enter = newline) / both false (button only). Keyboard handling lives in `PromptTextBox_PreviewKeyDown`. See issue #70

+- Send button position (v311.0): `SendButtonInToolbar` (sub-option of "Button only", enabled only while that radio is checked). `ApplySendButtonPlacement()` (UserInput.cs) re-parents the single `SendPromptButton` between `PromptBoxGrid` (column 1, bottom-aligned) and `RightButtonsPanel` (inserted just left of `AttachDropdownButton`, the pre-v227 slot) rather than keeping two buttons in sync, so every `IsEnabled`/`Visibility` write keeps working. It runs at the end of `ReorderToolbarControls()` — whose ordering would otherwise leave the button (not part of `ToolbarButtonOrder`) at the tail of the strip — which covers startup and Backup import, plus explicitly after Settings Apply. The native chat composer's `ComposerSendButton` is not affected.

- Dialog construction: Built programmatically (no XAML); reuses `MakeSectionHeader`/`MakeCheckBox`/`MakeRadioButton`/`MakeThemedComboBox` helpers and `GetThemeBrushes`/`GetDialogButtonStyle` from CustomCommands.cs

- Batched apply: all settings persisted once on OK via a single `SaveSettings()`. Side effects fire in order: prompt button visibility → font size → `ApplyLayoutSettingsChange()` → theme repaint (`UpdateTerminalTheme`/`UpdateInlineUsageBarColors`) → usage refresh → at most one terminal restart (terminal-type change, or theme/custom-color change AND user confirms the restart popup — popup gated by `SkipThemeRestartPrompt`, terminal-not-running, agent-color-matches)

- Search (v294.0): a box above the tabs (`ThemedDialogSearchBoxStyle` via `ThemedDialog.LoadStyle`, since this dialog does not `PrepareResources`) drives `UI/SettingsSearchFilter`, which walks the controls the dialog built — no per-setting registration. Text searched: captions, tooltips, combo items, tab and section headers, each also through `Loc.English` (reverse map of the active language) so English names match in any language; case, accents and word order are ignored (`SettingsSearch.Normalize`/`Matches`, unit-tested); a `TextBox`'s own text is never searched. Structure rules: a header tagged `SettingsSearch.SectionHeaderTag` (set by `MakeSectionHeader`) keeps its whole section when it matches and stays while anything under it matches; a plain `TextBlock` after a setting is its hint and goes with it; vertical stacks holding check boxes / radio buttons / headers are filtered recursively, while a label + text box stays one leaf; a matching tab name shows the whole tab; tabs with nothing left are hidden and the selection moves to the first match. Only visible elements are hidden and remembered, so whatever the dialog collapsed itself stays collapsed when the query is cleared. Ctrl+F focuses the box, Esc clears it, and a language preview re-runs the search.

v311.0: Option to show the Send button in the toolbar again

- Settings > Prompt gets "Show the Send button in the toolbar instead of the
  prompt box", a sub-option of "Button only" send mode (off by default).
- When on, the panel's Send button is re-parented into the toolbar strip just
  left of the attach button, where it was before v227.0; when off it stays in
  the bottom-right corner of the prompt box.
- One button is moved instead of keeping two in sync, so existing enable and
  visibility updates keep working. Placement re-runs after the toolbar is
  reordered (startup, backup import) and after Settings Apply.
- The native chat composer's own Send button is unchanged.
- New strings translated in all 19 language files.
EOF
git log -1 --format='%an <%ae>%n%B' | cat && git push -q origin master 2>&1 | tail -3; git status -sb | head -1
